_meta.dataset: Non-restaurant activities, each tied to a transit-time check against a hotel
_meta.selection_rule: Every activity lists travel mode and whether the <=60 minute door-to-door target was met, measured with Google Maps transit routing.

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.hours: Mon-Fri: every 30 min 3:00-7:30 PM, then every 15 min 8:00 PM-midnight. Sat/Sun/holidays: every 30 min 12:00-7:30 PM, then every 15 min 8:00 PM-midnight.
activities.exceptions: Schedule may vary; outdoor display subject to cancellation in bad weather.
activities.transit_note: Walk, not transit. Bellagio is directly across Flamingo Rd from the ranked #1 hotel.
activities.verified: hours, days, price and walk time all verified

activities.name: The High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.hours: Opens 12:00 PM daily; daytime tickets valid 12:00-5:59 PM, anytime tickets from 6:00 PM to close.
activities.exceptions: One rotation is 30 min; allow an hour to board and exit. Happy Half Hour (21+) from $60 incl. open bar. Seniors 65+ $5 off Sun-Thu 12-5 PM. Nevada locals 20% off Jan & Jun only.
activities.transit_note: Walk, 0.3 mile / 7 min via Las Vegas Blvd S from Flamingo.
activities.price_note: Adult daytime $23.50; adult anytime $34.75; youth 4-12 $8.50. Plus tax and fees. Source: official Caesars page.
activities.verified: hours, prices, days, walk time verified

activities.name: The Mob Museum (National Museum of Organized Crime and Law Enforcement)
activities.hours: Museum daily 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM. The Underground (speakeasy/distillery) Sun-Thu 11 AM-11 PM, Fri-Sat 11 AM-midnight.
activities.exceptions: Hours subject to change and early closures; museum publishes an early-closure list. Online reservations strongly encouraged for online-only discounts.
activities.transit_note: 55 min via RTC Deuce from Sammy Davis Jr Blvd. Within the 60-minute rule but at the edge - a Downtown day (Mob Museum + Esther's Kitchen + Arts District) makes far more sense than three separate trips.
activities.price_note: Ticket price not published as a single figure on the page fetched; buy via official ticket store. Not inferred.
activities.verified: hours, days and transit verified; ticket price unverified

activities.exceptions: Programming is concert/residency driven and changes constantly; the Feb 2027 line-up is NOT announced and cannot be verified 15 months out.
activities.transit_note: 25 min from Flamingo (1.1 miles). Walkable from Venetian/Palazzo/Wynn.
activities.price_note: No published standard price; varies by show and seat. Not inferred.
